entities.name: Buddhist Sailendra
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Buddhist Sailendra, a notable figure in the history of Indonesia, associated with Classical Javanese Kingdoms (732–929). Their legacy influenced Construction of Borobudur, the world's largest Buddhist monument and Construction of Prambanan, the largest Hindu temple in Southeast Asia.
